headline: Names a Milwaukee, Wisconsin Postal Service building the "Vel R. Phillips Post Office Building."
what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility at 2650 North Doctor Martin Luther King Jr. Drive in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The building will be officially called the "Vel R. Phillips Post Office Building." It is a naming measure and does not change how the post office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 6, 2018, and the new name applies from that date.
